name: atlas
description: ATLAS: how a coding assistant talks to you, and what it can do.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus two subagents that keep searches and pages out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear.

plugins.name: atlas-min
plugins.description: Compression only: two levels (low/high) and what makes them work. No rigour dial, no verification, no subagents, no extra commands. The rules that go beyond compression are removed from this package, not switched off.

plugins.name: atlas-code
plugins.description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus ten subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant adds coding and documents: review by language, build fixing, tests, verification, planning, shipping, specs, changelogs and the rest, each read only when used.

plugins.name: atlas-mem
plugins.description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus five subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant adds review, build fixing and a memory: notes written by hand, linked to code, and flagged as suspect when that code or what it depends on changes.

plugins.name: atlas-video
plugins.description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus two subagents that keep searches and pages out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant adds video made on this machine: written with HyperFrames, Remotion or Manim, or recorded from the screen with a camera that follows the cursor.

plugins.name: atlas-max
plugins.description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus ten subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant is everything ATLAS ships: coding, documents and the memory. Install it instead of atlas-code and atlas-mem, never beside them.
